name: Arboretum Village
summary: Arboretum Village is a Tom Thumb-anchored community center featuring 95,354 square feet of retail space with a strong mix of grocery, home improvement, pet care, and dining options. Located near White Rock Lake and Dallas Arboretum, the center serves an affluent trade area with over 131,000 residents averaging $144,000 household income within 3 miles.
demographics: Arboretum Village serves an affluent, highly educated trade area with over 131,000 residents within 3 miles averaging $144,000 in household income. The primary market consists of college-educated professionals and families (50% hold college degrees) who value convenience and quality. The center benefits from proximity to White Rock Lake and Dallas Arboretum, attracting active, health-conscious visitors and tourists, with the botanical garden drawing over 844,000 annual visits that provide additional foot traffic to the shopping center.
description: Arboretum Village is a well-established Tom Thumb-anchored community shopping center strategically located at 7331 Gaston Avenue in Dallas, Texas. Spanning 95,354 square feet, this open-air center serves the affluent neighborhoods surrounding White Rock Lake with a carefully curated mix of national retailers and local businesses. The property features prominent anchors including Tom Thumb grocery store, PetSmart, and Ace Hardware, complemented by popular dining destinations like IHOP, White Rock Alehouse & Brewery, and Raising Cane's. The center's exceptional visibility from over 37,000 vehicles daily on Garland Road and 23,000 vehicles daily on Gaston Avenue ensures strong customer traffic. Located just one mile from the renowned Dallas Arboretum and Botanical Garden and with direct access to White Rock Lake trailheads, Arboretum Village benefits from both residential shoppers and recreational visitors exploring one of Dallas's most desirable neighborhoods.
